activity.name: Swim with Dolphins
activity.description: Experience the thrill of swimming with dolphins in their natural habitat.

activity.name: Kitesurfing at Le Morne
activity.description: Catch the perfect winds for kitesurfing at the UNESCO World Heritage site of Le Morne.

activity.name: Hiking in Black River Gorges
activity.description: Explore the lush forests and scenic trails of Black River Gorges National Park.

activity.name: Visit the Chamarel Waterfall
activity.description: Experience the beauty of Chamarel Waterfall and its surrounding landscapes.

activity.name: Zipline At La Vallée des Couleurs
activity.photo_source: Picture From La Vallée des Couleurs Site
activity.description: La Vallée des Couleurs in Mauritius is a nature park with diverse flora and fauna, including endemic species.

activity.name: Tube Ride
activity.description: One of the most popular exciting water-sports activities with a duration of approximately 5-7 minutes in the mesmerizing lagoon. Bounce on the waves behind a speedboat and get thrilled!

activity.name: Snorkel with Dolphins
activity.description: Dolphins watch, Swimming and snorkeling with dolphins with all equipment available free on board.Furthermore going ahead,swim close to and also touching the big crystal rock.

activity.name: Splash and Fun Leisure Park - WaterPark
activity.description: The Black Hole is more for the daring souls, ready to feel the thrill of a launching rocket. Fear not as you’ll soon enjoy a smooth landing into a beautiful pool.

activity.name: Kayaking
activity.description: Embark on a kayaking adventure to Amber island and paddle through a floating mangrove forest. Enjoy a guided tour of the island.

activity.name: Private Catamaran Charter to Ile aux Cerfs
activity.description: Climb aboard the Island Hopper catamaran and enjoy a private charter to the breathtaking Ile aux Cerfs. Get the chance to swim in turquoise waters and snorkel.

activity.name: Seabob Diving
activity.description: Enjoy an exciting sea adventure on a Seabob, which is a self-controlled device allowing you to explore the ocean at high-speed.

activity.name: Parasailing
activity.description: Make a splash with an adventure day of waterspont activities in Mauritius. Feel the adrenaline thrill of parasailing.

activity.name: Casela Nature Park
activity.description: Explore Casela Nature Parks; 350-hectare wonderland divided into 5 zones: Thrill Mountain: For adventure seekers, offering zip-lining and Nepalese Bridge. Predator Kingdom: Get close to lions, tigers, and cheetahs, guided by experts. African Safari: Witness giraffes, zebras, rhinos, and exotic birds in a simulated African environment and Eco-ryder tour.
